zh: 改善安装时的 Office 文件夹授权流程：App 先完成安装，再按提示授权并安装 Word 插件。App 内现在也能为当前用户首次安装插件，无需重新打开系统安装器。保留已有 Word 组件和其他加载项，包含此前的长拼音组字保护与 Word 自动启动修复。
en: Improves Office folder consent during installation: install the app first, then grant folder access and finish Word plugin setup from the app. First-time plugin setup now runs for the current user without reopening macOS Installer. Preserves existing Word components and other add-ins, and includes the previous Chinese composition and Word startup fixes.
